description: Zero‑dependency, ultra‑fast Node.js framework that gives Express‑level simplicity with type‑safe routing, built‑in security, AI‑ready hooks, and native edge/serverless support.
npm_trending_strategy: Version 0.0.108‑daily ships with native ESM, built‑in OpenAPI generation, and AI‑ready hook system—all without pulling in a single dependency. It targets the 2026 surge in edge‑first and serverless workloads, giving developers a tiny, secure, and observable runtime that outperforms Express and Fastify on cold‑start latency and bundle size.
download_hooks: Lightning‑fast request handling (sub‑microsecond routing) with zero‑dependency footprint.
Built‑in security & validation eliminates the need for extra packages like helmet or joi.
Native ESM & TypeScript typings give instant IDE autocompletion and type safety.
One‑click OpenAPI spec generation saves time on API documentation.
AI‑ready lifecycle hooks let you plug LLM‑based request enrichment without extra libs.
Designed for edge and serverless environments – minimal cold‑start overhead.
Observable metrics and tracing baked in, no extra monitoring setup required.
